findings.title: Missing sender metadata causes installation callback to crash
findings.body: This directly indexes `integration.metadata["sender"]["login"]`, but integrations created before this check—or installations whose webhook did not populate `sender`—may have no `sender` key (or no `login`). In that case the callback raises `KeyError` and returns a server error instead of the intended invalid-installation response, preventing legitimate reinstalls and leaving the user without the documented failure flow. Handle absent or malformed sender metadata as a validation failure.
